'''Reskell Twane''' was an Imperial official who served as [[Trioculus]]' predecessor as [[Lord Overseer]] of the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. Prior to becoming Lord Overseer, he was in the service of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. During Twane's rule, [[Niobi]] and her newborn son Trioculus were deported to Kessel and suffered from Twane's rule. After Niobi's death, Twane took pity on Trioculus and took the three-eyed mutant under his wing, sending him to school.<ref name="Barely Tolerable" />

Following the death of [[Dewt Kluskine]], Twane was transferred to Kluskine's position as [[Warden/Legends|warden]] while Trioculus was made Lord Overseer. Following the death of Jabba the Hutt, Twane's prisoners revolted and Twane was subsequently captured by the [[Rybet/Legends|Rybet]] [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] [[Moruth Doole]]. Doole later offered Twane to Trioculus in exchange for control over the Supreme Slavelord's region of Kessel. When Trioculus refused the offer, Doole fed Twane [[spice grub]]s and froze him in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] amid his screams of agony.<ref name="Barely Tolerable" />
